|hair = Black|eyes = Dark}}'''Aiden Shimura''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Aiden Shimura}}

==Appearance==
She is a shy, withdrawn woman.

She is round and very dark, even darker than [[Zemaille]].{{ref/book|10|21}} She has black hair and dark eyes.

==Strength==
As with the other Aes Sedai of ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' origin, Aiden is relatively weak in the [[One Power]].

==History==
Aiden lied about her age when she enrolled as a [[novice]].

She is one of the few ''Atha'an Miere'' sisters and works in the [[White Tower Library]], along with [[Nyein]] and [[Zemaille]], the other Sea Folk Aes Sedai. They tend to stay alone on the upper levels of the library with the [[Thirteenth Depository|secret records]].

At the time of the [[Dragon Reborn]]'s birth, there were four Sea Folk Aes Sedai in the White Tower, and two of them were almost 300 years old. Aiden is one of the younger two.

==Activities==
She is in the library when [[Alviarin Freidhen]] is creeping around the 9th Depository. Her presence saves Zemaille from death at the [[Black Ajah|Black sister's]] hand. {{ref/book|10|21}}
